rows.fact: RNN recurrence a_t = f(U x_t + W a_{t-1}), y_t = g(V a_t)
a_t is the hidden state

rows.fact: factors < 1 drive the product to 0, > 1 to infinity

rows.phrase: keep a path along which the gradient survives

rows.fact: LSTM: x_t and h_{t-1} concatenated, fed to four parallel layers
three sigmoid gates act as selectors, outputs in [0,1] multiply streams
forget gate f_t = σ(W_f[h_{t-1},x_t]): what to erase from C_{t-1}
input gate i_t and candidate C̃_t = tanh(W_C[...]): what to write
output gate o_t: what part of the cell to expose
C_t = f ⊙ C_{t-1} + i ⊙ C̃_t; h_t = o ⊙ tanh(C_t)
rows.phrase: the cell is added to, not rewritten

rows.fact: cell state updated additively, like a skip connection; gradients flow along C largely unmultiplied; this solves vanishing gradients
rows.phrase: It is a skip connection through time
rows.note: qualified: one protected path scaled by the forget gate, not a full solution

rows.fact: GRU: simplified LSTM, update z and reset r gates, cell and hidden merged
rows.phrase: The GRU: two gates, one state
one gate doing the forget and input jobs together

rows.fact: ~25% fewer parameters
rows.note: made exact: 3/4 at equal width, derived
